2026-09-18 04:08:55.936982 | controller | template units). This means they are not meant to be enabled or disabled using systemctl.
2026-09-18 04:08:55.937001 | controller |
2026-09-18 04:08:55.937010 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-09-18 04:08:55.937018 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-09-18 04:08:55.937035 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.

2026-09-18 04:08:55.937053 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-09-18 04:08:55.937070 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
2026-09-18 04:08:55.937089 | controller |   D-Bus, udev, scripted systemctl call, ...).
2026-09-18 04:08:55.937107 | controller | • In case of template units, the unit is meant to be enabled with some
2026-09-18 04:08:55.937116 | controller |   instance name specified.
